title: FoxxBoyy's End Update
description: This mod adds stuff to the end dimension without making it feel like a totally different dimension
body:
# This mod adds:
## 3 new biomes:
- Void Wastes
- Ender Badlands
- Endergrowth
## Cave Generation
## Enderite:
- Enderite tools
- Enderite ore
- Enderite armor
- Enderite block
## Endstone versions of iron and diamond ores
## Cobbled end stone
## Ender veins:
- Ender veins
- Ender vein block
- Raw ender vein block
## Dead wood
- Dead planks (+ stairs, slabs, fence gates)
- Dead wood
- Dead log
## New commands
- "/end" teleports you to the end
- "/dragon" kills the ender dragon
## Endertoxin (fluid that damages anything that touches it)
